title: nixos/pgadmin: Use lib.mkEnableOption where possible
reason: Real declaration-style change: emailServer.enable/useSSL/useTLS converted from plain mkOption(bool) to mkEnableOption (matches the coordinator's flagged title exactly). No functional/branch change, same option names and semantics.
targets_toml: Self-corrected: option_prefix=[services,pgadmin,emailServer] (prefix ending at the bare nested attrset 'emailServer') gave 0 discovered_options -- same class of mistake seen repeatedly this round. Corrected to option_prefix=[services,pgadmin], watch=['emailServer.enable'], which found 15 discovered_options.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: CONTROLLED DECLARATION-STYLE INSTANCE (mkOption->mkEnableOption, distinct from mkPackageOption): unlike mkPackageOption's proven non-discovery regression, converting a plain mkOption(bool) to mkEnableOption here caused NO discoverability change at all -- identical TestConfigUnresolved verdict, identical 4 real predicate_attempts (same 3 use-sites, all witnessed=false), both before and after. This is useful negative evidence: not every declaration-style change causes the mkPackageOption-style blackout; mkEnableOption itself does not regress discovery.
